about_the_game:
A group of little kittens has secretly hidden inside the paintings, waiting for you to discover them!

You will explore 20 exquisite illustrations from "A Dream of Red Mansions," finding cleverly hidden kittens tucked away behind pavilions, within rockeries and flower bushes, or even playfully mimicking the poses of the characters in the scenes.

  • Fun for All Ages
    The game is completely wordless! Whether for young children, seniors, or international friends, there are no language barriers. Everyone can easily enjoy the fun of the hunt. It's also a wonderful opportunity to cultivate children's observation skills and artistic sensibility.

  • A Relaxing Experience
    Unwind to soothing music and search at your own pace.
    Stuck? A gentle tap on the hint button will help you proceed without frustration.
    Find 10 cats, and earn an adorable badge.
    Collect them all to become a true "Master Cat Finder"!

  • A Child's First Lesson in Honglou Aesthetics
    The game's scenes are faithfully recreated from the classic silk album paintings by the Qing Dynasty artist Sun Wen. A passionate folk admirer of the epic, Sun Wen dedicated half his life to creating this masterpiece, visually interpreting the main storylines of the timeless literary classic, "A Dream of Red Mansions." It is the perfect visual gateway into this legendary world.

    As children search for the kittens, their eyes will wander across the painted towers, intricate costumes, and expressive characters. This is not only excellent training for their observation skills but also a precious introduction to traditional Chinese aesthetics. Sun Wen's paintings are like a "silent TV series," naturally sparking children's interest in the story of "A Dream of Red Mansions" and its rich cultural heritage.

Perfect For:

  • Families seeking quality time together.

  • Anyone who loves art, history, and cats.

  • Those looking for a relaxing escape from a busy day.

  • Children who need to practice observation and concentration.
